description: FREE, offline. Before a user sends or a support agent confirms a deposit address: detects the address family (EVM, TRON, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, XRP, ...), validates checksum and format, cross-checks it against the intended network, flags missing memo/tag for exchange deposits and known token-contract addresses. Verdict: ok, caution, do_not_send or incomplete. Cannot see balances or sanctions lists.

memo.description: Memo / destination tag the user plans to include (TON, XRP, XLM, ...)

network.description: Network the user intends to send on (omit to check format only)

recipient.description: Who receives: exchange deposit address, own wallet, or someone else

name: check_crypto_address
title: Pre-send address check (free)
